index.html.heading: Compare the ownership decision before you buy the book
index.html.body:
Review the reading guide, compare total occupancy costs and organize the property due-diligence questions that apply to your situation.

The book is a starting point for evaluating ownership, not a property-specific financing or return recommendation. Check book availability and confirm the edition and format that suit your reading needs.
